Class MoreTypes

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.MoreTypes
public final class MoreTypes extends Object
Checks and conversions on TypeMirrors that javax.lang.model does not provide.

The as... methods that return a type, rather than an Optional, cast a type whose kind the caller knows, such as after a switch on its kind. They go by that kind, as TypeMirror recommends, and fail with a message naming the type and its kind, where a cast would throw a ClassCastException naming javac's implementation classes.

    • isCastFromObjectUnchecked

      public static boolean isCastFromObjectUnchecked(TypeMirror type)
      Returns whether casting an Object to a type is an unchecked cast: one the runtime cannot fully check, so that javac warns about it. Generated code that casts to such a type needs a reason it is safe.

      A cast is unchecked to a type variable; to a parameterized type with a type argument other than ? or ? extends Object, such as List<String> or List<? super Object>; to an inner class of such a type, such as Outer<String>.Inner; to an array of any of these; and to an intersection type with any of these among its bounds. A cast to a raw type, to List<?> or to a primitive type is checked.

      Parameters:
      type - the type to cast to
      Returns:
      true if casting an Object to type is unchecked
